tvShow.name: Adults
tvShow.overview: A group of twenty-somethings in New York trying to be good people, despite being neither "good" nor "people" yet.

episodes.overview: A stabber is on the loose in the neighborhood and the group realizes Anton may have accidentally befriended him.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In season 1, the housemates tackle capital-R Responsibility to varying degrees of success. These friends are works-in-progress, brimming with bad ideas and whatever their latest "theory of adulthood" might be. But there's one thing they consistently get right: showing up for each other.

episodes.name: The Scrub
episodes.overview: The housemates uncover Paul Baker's long-kept secret.

episodes.name: Fake ID
episodes.overview: Billie befriends the 20-year-old who inherited her fake ID.

episodes.name: Talia
episodes.overview: Anton learns that his sister is starting a family, while Issa begins thinking about her own fertility.

episodes.name: Raccoon

episodes.name: Pop Girlie
episodes.overview: Samir's girlfriend Carly makes a drastic career change, and Anton grapples with the power of his influence.

episodes.name: C Alert
episodes.overview: Anton makes a rare mistake at work, and Issa steps up to help him fix it.

episodes.name: Vote for Paul Baker
episodes.overview: Paul Baker runs for president of the Homeowners Association, and into an uncertain future.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season 2, the housemates tackle a new set of real-world questions. What if the 20-year-old who inherited your fake ID is cooler than you ever were, and younger than you'll ever be again? How do you explain to your friends that you actually love your boring office job? Why does being around your family make you regress into your worst self? And how do you ask for things to change, when you also need everything to stay the same? Together, the friends weave intricate webs of multi-player strategy just to avoid hurting someone else's feelings. They invent elaborate workarounds for problems they're too afraid to face head-on. It's not so much that they keep learning the same lessons – it's that they keep finding new ways to make mistakes. But the one thing they consistently get right: showing up for each other.

reviews.author: DogsLoveMe
reviews.content: This is such a try-hard show that wants to be something that it will never ever be: clever. The cast is hilariously diverse and the show's writing is incredibly banal and BLAH. Unfunny but of course it checks all the boxes so it will most definitely be renewed, despite absolutely no one watching.

reviews.author: lonelyroadtrip
reviews.content: this is like if new girl was set in the 2020s and had more conflicting relationships. it is enjoyable, an easy watch—letting the characters make their way into your heart gives delicious payoff.
